'''Osaji Varane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Varane worked for the [[Osaji Syndicate]], a criminal organization that was ran by his father, [[Osaji Shimka]]. Following Shimka's [[Death/Legends|death]], control of the syndicate passed to Varane and his two siblings, [[Osaji Hux]] and [[Osaji Uhares]]. Varane established a career for himself on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]], working as a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]], and he was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] on the world by a group of agents that had been hired by Osaji Hux.
